cases.name: Energy conservation in the room solve

cases.name: Inter-reflection against an independent photon trace of a 6 by 4 m office
Sky law, worked by hand
cases.result: A roof light that sees the whole sky gives Eext within 0.5 %; an endless vertical window gives half of it on a horizontal plane within 1 %; vertical illuminance facing the sky is 0.396 of Eext within 1 %

cases.name: Light entering a room through a window
cases.result: The lumens that reach the room's surfaces equal T times the vertical sky illuminance times the glass area, 0.15 % apart on a 6 by 4 m room with a 3 m window

cases.name: Obstruction
cases.result: With no bounced light, points behind a full-height partition get no direct light and points in front are unchanged; touching a face is not a hit

cases.name: Emergency lighting
cases.result: Floor lux under one luminaire equals share times I over d squared; a partition blocks it. The limits it is checked against are unverified and wait for a lighting engineer

cases.name: Road lighting, worked by hand
